g.text: Local protection continues during supervisory-link loss. A power cycle retains the latch.
Hardwired zero-opening pump permits are separate from sampled PLC commands.
M1 emits private engineering states/work records only. Dispatch and delivered multi-source
evidence interfaces remain later tickets; no hidden-state decision oracle is claimed.

g.text: Access to loc_it also requires gate permission, floor water below10 kg and room
temperature below the directional work limit. Qualification/tool/shift rules still apply.
The shared portable flow meter is occupied during travel and work.
Arrival, engineering work, diagnosis, repair and verified closure remain different states.

g.text: V6 architecture v2: four relation semantics, shared entity IDs
Shared IDs refer to the same V6 entities. Access arrowheads follow the actual bidirectional fields.
Synthetic research facility inspired by Zhengzhou; this is not a site P&ID. As-built feeders, coolant, hydraulics, staffing and floor plan remain unresolved.
